proven_claims: CLOSED (wave 2026-08-25 night): the whole GanttChart wrapper decodes and both records round-trip byte for byte -- see `parse_moxel_gantt_chart`/`push_moxel_gantt_chart_xml` in src/mssql_dump/moxel.rs and regression tests `renders_gantt_chart_with_elements_not_init_to_platform_proven_xml`/`renders_gantt_chart_with_elements_init_to_platform_proven_xml` in src/mssql_dump/tests.rs.

IMPORTANT CORRECTION found only by testing against native UT 11.5.27.75's own 1cv8.cf directly (not this fixture's raw_entry files): `parse_moxel_drawing`'s own `fields[12]` (the whole object slot, as split from the real `<drawing>` record) carries ONE EXTRA WRAPPING BRACE around the `{19,...}` object for `GanttChart` specifically -- `{ {19,...} }`, a single member with no top-level comma -- unlike the plain `Chart` kind, whose `fields[12]` is `{{11},{74,...}}` with no such extra wrap. This fixture's `raw/*-object-payload.txt` files are already the UNWRAPPED `{19,...}` text (a prior wave sliced them by searching for that marker directly inside a whole-document `cf extract`, not via the object-level `cf extract <cf> <uuid>.0` the `description` fields above literally name), so unit tests built directly against them never exercised the wrap and passed while the real corpus export still produced zero `<drawing>` elements for both GanttChart templates (`ut` gate stayed at `exact=50456`, unchanged, on the first attempt this wave). Found by decoding native UT 11.5.27.75's real `1cv8.cf` through the full `parse_moxel_spreadsheet_text` pipeline (not just the isolated payload) and observing `parse_moxel_drawing` return `None` where the isolated-payload test returned `Some`. Fixed in `parse_moxel_drawing`'s `GanttChart` match arm: unwrap `fields[12]` one more level (`split_1c_braced_fields`, require exactly one member) before calling `parse_moxel_gantt_chart`.

The GanttChart object payload's own top-level shape is `{19, <32 more top-level fields>}` -- 33 fields total. Field[1] is `{0,{11},{74,...}}` (the plain-Chart `parse_moxel_chart`-compatible payload, re-wrapped by stripping the leading `0,`); fields[2..33) are GanttChart-specific.

field[2]/field[3] are `<d3p1:points>`/`<d3p1:series>`: `{1,{3,0,1,0,<value>,<contentCacheItem>,<autoText>,0}}` / `{0,{3,0,1,0,<value>,<contentCacheItem>,<autoText>,0}}` respectively, where `<value>`'s key record `{8,0,0,0,0,0,{"U"},{1,0},{"U"},0,<baseData>}` is shared (only `baseData` -- the cache-template id -- and `autoText` vary; both proven on two independent values each across the two records). `points` alone carries an extra `font`/`picture` pair its `value` element has and `series` does not.

field[6] is `drawEmpty` (bool). field[7] is `<d3p1:timeScale>`: `{3,0,1,<level>,<transparent=false>,<backColor>,<textColor=style:FormTextColor>,<currentLevel=0>}`, with `<level>` `{8,<measure>,<interval=1>,<show>,<line>,<scaleColor=#C0C0C0>,<dayFormatRule>,<format=empty>,<labels.ticks=0>,<backColor=auto>,<textColor=auto>,<showPereodicalLabels=true>}`. `measure` and `dayFormatRule` are enums proven at two codes each; `show` and `backColor` are real per-record fields (`backColor` reuses `parse_moxel_chart_color`, extended with a new `-10` = `style:FieldBackColor` code this fixture is the first to need); `line` is the fixed `width=1`/`Dotted` record, unvaried.

field[9] (`fixedVariantMeasure`) shares its code table with `level.measure` (`moxel_gantt_time_measure`: `10`=Minute, `20`=Hour, `30`=Day, `50`=Month -- evenly spaced by 10, suggesting an unobserved longer ladder this reader does not guess at).

field[12], field[13] and field[14] are dates in a fixed 14-digit `YYYYMMDDHHMMSS` numeric-string format (no separators), matching `<d3p1:fullIntervalBegin>`, `<d3p1:fullIntervalEnd>` and `<d3p1:visualBegin>` (ISO `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS`) respectively in both examples.

field[15] (`intervalDrawType`) is a two-code enum: `0`=Flat, `3`=Gradient. field[22]/field[25] (`outboundColor`/`linksColor`) reuse `parse_moxel_chart_color`'s existing direct-RGB branch unchanged. field[26] (`linksLine`) reuses `parse_moxel_chart_line` unchanged (width 1, Solid). field[31] (`textPlacement`) is a two-code enum: `0`=Auto, `1`=Cut.

field[19] (`verticalScrollEnable`) is a real bool field, proven independently by a `seed.sh`-built control (`gantt-control`, CommonTemplate `GanttChartTest` on the `Web_Service` skeleton, holding the `dlitelnost` record's own bytes) with only this one XML element toggled true.

The rest of the wrapper (fields 4, 5, 8, 10, 11, 16, 17, 18, 20, 21, 23, 24, 27, 28, 29, 30, 32) is validated as a positional literal, unvaried between the two native records -- same treatment `parse_moxel_chart` already gives most of the plain Chart's own tail/post.
non_claims: Every literal field above is validated against exactly two native examples, not derived from seed variation (the seed factory can round-trip a hand-built GanttChart CommonTemplate -- see `gantt-control` -- but cannot force alternate values for most of these fields without a real Designer session). `showPointsText`/`showData`/`intervalTextRepresentation` (fields 28/29/30, hard-coded `Show`/`Auto`/`Auto` in the writer) and `keepScaleVariant`/`fixedVariantInterval`/`autoFullInterval`/`noneVariantChars`/`noneVariantMeasure`/`verticalStretch`/`showValueText`/`extTitle` in particular are single-value observations that could in principle take other codes a future record might need.

The plain Chart payload embedded as field[1] needed five new real fields plus one new chartType code beyond what the pre-existing 13-record corpus ever exercised -- see moxel.rs's `MoxelChart`/`validate_moxel_chart_v74_front` doc comments, not repeated here.
